current_task_corrections.correction: Change denial_code_ranking scope from 'all_claims' to 'denied_claims' so that each code's share is its proportion of denials (shares sum to 1), not its proportion of all claims.
Set denial_code_ranking scope parameter to 'denied_claims' to comply with statistical discipline: codes should be ranked among denied claims only.
Add 'synthetic_data' to write_report caveats parameter to disclose that the analysis uses synthetic data.

reusable_lessons.lesson: When ranking denial codes, calculate shares among denied claims only. This ensures each code's share represents its proportion of actual denials, not diluted across all claims which may lack codes.
Include the 'synthetic_data' caveat in all analysis reports when working with synthetic datasets to transparently communicate data limitations to stakeholders.
